definitions.noiseMetric: absolute RMS raw minus denoised; includes denoising bias and is not an independent ground truth
definitions.luminance: Rec.709 coefficients on scene-linear or decoded display RGB; never encoded sRGB averages

shortlist.rule: Across all five views, minimize four times clipped fraction plus high saturation fraction; tie-break by light id. Provisional diagnostic ranking, not a photorealism score. L00 always final; L05 weather is separate.

regionPolicy: Normalized image rectangles are diagnostic crops, not semantic segmentation. Bus/material masks come from Cycles IndexMA/IndexOB and source material names. Sun/sky leakage requires pass evidence, not darkness alone.
